assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for a photographic torn-paper collage surfing game. Reference image 1 is IDENTITY reference: the rider must be this bald adult man with dark eyebrows, close-trimmed dark beard and moustache, broad forehead, warm brown eyes and sturdy physique. NO HAIR on scalp. Reference image 2 is STYLE reference: sun faded photographic paper cutouts, thick rough ivory torn-paper silhouette, tactile salt-speckled print. Create the same red/ivory jetski with this bald man riding it wearing a dark forest-green sleeveless rashguard, bright yellow life jacket, charcoal shorts. Exactly three equally wide square cells in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, 3:1 landscape atlas. Cell 1 full left-facing side view from slightly above. Cell 2 full right-facing side view from slightly above. Cell 3 full rear view moving away, his visibly bald head and shoulders clearly visible. Same scale and baseline, entire vehicle/rider inside each cell with generous transparent padding 7% on all sides. Do not overlap cells. Match recognizable face to identity reference in both profiles, not the curly surfer. True transparency between and around cutouts. A modest paper-cut white water spray hugging the hull is allowed. No lettering, no logos, no background, no extra people, no board, no mug, no detached shadow. High quality game-ready clean silhouettes.

Use case: texture / game UI background asset. One blank, tactile ivory torn paper rectangle, landscape 3:2, photographed flat head on, deckled ripped edges on all four sides, warm offwhite cotton fiber, very subtle pale beige salt stains and wrinkles, natural rough handmade paper silhouette, center clean and evenly bright for dark game HUD text, no text no drawings no objects no fold shadow no background. Genuine transparent exterior with generous 6% padding. Style: sun faded Mediterranean scrapbook paper collage. This is a single reusable background plate for a game's menus, dialogue and HUD.

Use case: stylized-concept / four-panel story atlas for a game visual novel. Create ONE square image divided into exactly FOUR equally-sized square panels, seamless 2x2 grid with no gutters; each cell its own complete scene. Reference 1 is the surfer MAX identity: curly brown hair, white tank, green floral shorts, blue board, one glass mug of amber drink. Reference 2 is BORIS identity: completely bald adult man with dark eyebrows and closely trimmed beard. Reference 3 is visual STYLE: vivid photographic torn-paper summer scrapbook collage, ivory paper borders around human silhouettes, cyan blue sea, coral and saffron setting sun, halftone printed details. TOP LEFT: wide establishing scene, cozy little beach bar on a rocky Mediterranean pier at sunset, worried grey-haired barman in orange apron holding a blank wooden sign and looking at MAX who has his mug and board, expressive friendly comedy, not gloomy. TOP RIGHT: heroic adventurous MAX pushing his blue surfboard from the pier into blue foaming waves, raising mug with determination, golden setting sun huge behind him, dynamic motion. BOTTOM LEFT: BORIS bald and clearly different from curly MAX, riding a red and ivory jetski wearing a yellow life vest over dark green sleeveless rashguard, looking surprised and calling toward distant MAX while making an enormous foaming curved wake, good natured comedy. BOTTOM RIGHT: scenic wide GARRET bay with three curling surf waves leading to a tiny beach bar and cheering friends on the pier; MAX on board seen from behind heading to the bar, evening still bright, celebratory hopeful ending. Polished game cinematic comic artwork with strong camera angles and dramatic physical paper layering, consistent sea and coastal town across all cells. Faces must be natural and recognizable, adult friendly not children. Absolutely NO lettering, no words, no captions, no speech bubbles, no fake UI, no watermark. Images will be cropped into individual panels by the game; keep main characters near each cell center with breathing room.

Use case: stylized-concept / isolated photographic game environment cutout. Reference 1 is a seaside town photo collage, keep its Mediterranean architecture, pastel yellow and coral houses, bell tower, cypresses, palms and jagged grey rock cliffs. Reference 2 is the game style: printed photographic summer torn-paper collage with bold ivory ripped silhouettes and halftone flecks. Generate ONE tall portrait 3:4 isolated cliffside village island silhouette, ALL buildings and stone surfaces fully OPAQUE and continuous, with no holes or transparency inside the town. Town and high bell tower rise on the RIGHT side of a rocky limestone cliff, cliff tapers toward left at the bottom to meet blue seawater, broad complete silhouettes. A continuous thin warm ivory torn-paper outline around the entire village and cliff, not individual confetti. Transparent background only OUTSIDE the island silhouette with generous padding. No sky, no sun, no clouds, no gulls, no humans, no text, no arrows, no UI. Sharp photographic stone and roof texture, sunlit evening warm light. Avoid fragmented transparent architecture or faded transparent pixels inside the island. Game-ready isolated coast scenic sprite.
